ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (25) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Заблуждение» (zabluzhdeniye) is 'error' in both the opening and the closing thought; in the ostrich passage «сомнительный» (somnitel'nyy, 'doubtful') and «верный» (vernyy, 'sure, certain') keep their repetitions. «Стоит со стороны взглянуть» (Stoit so storony vzglyanut') is 'One has only to look from outside', not the website draft's 'It is worth looking'; attributions as printed (Saadi, Carlyle, Lucy Mallory, Pascal).
